content: WordPress core documentation describes PHPUnit as the PHP automated test suite and recommends isolated test environments; WordPress Plugin Check is the official WordPress.org tool and supports static PHP_CodeSniffer/custom checks plus runtime checks through admin or WP-CLI. WordPress/plugin-check-action runs Plugin Check in CI. For this plugin, which has no current test suite, begin with lint/static checks and Plugin Check, then add a disposable WordPress integration environment and smoke/regression tests for activation, admin menus, CRUD, shortcodes, feeds, CSV and upgrades.
